extracted.name: Cream Cheese Peanut Butter Frosting
extracted.description: This peanut butter frosting recipe balances sweet and creamy ingredients for a rich, spreadable frosting; perfect with chocolate cake.
instruction_lines: Whip peanut butter, cream cheese, confectioners' sugar, brown sugar, and butter together in a mixing bowl until creamy. Mix in milk, a few drops at a time, until desired consistency is reached.
